Six ordered sections at spec fractions (14/20/8.5/12.5/25/20), 54/46 deck/keybed split, one continuous chassis, no marketing hero. Inherited, unchanged.
Stable control IDs, per-section landmarks and density, Program and Synth as the only primary OLEDs. Phase 2: Program OLED shows the live piano model; Synth stays decorative.
Pointer press/release/cancel, keyboard-operated keys, window blur releases all held notes. Inherited, unchanged.

Every visible control moves or presses via pointer and keyboard. Phase 2: the functional set (Piano, Effects, Master Level, Panic) writes engine state; organ/synth/program remain presentation-only — asserted both ways.
Slider roles with names/values, button pressed states, labeled keys/keybed/OLEDs, live status region, visible focus styling.
Note on/off, repeated/overlapping notes, per-note release audible in signal, all-notes-off, voice counts return to baseline, bounded polyphony. Inherited.
Pointer, independent multi-touch via pointerId, mapped computer keys with repeat suppression, MIDI note/velocity/CC64, denied and disconnected states, out-of-range MIDI ignored. Inherited.
Velocity response and sustain duration proven on rendered signal; concurrent voices; deterministic oldest-released-then-oldest-held stealing. Inherited.
Loading/ready transitions (recorded library), honest labeled silent fallback on error, blur/disconnect/unmount stop every owned voice. Inherited.

Six selectable types. Grand/Upright/Electric are bundled recorded sample sets (108 WAV takes on disk: 18 roots × 2 velocity layers × 3 types, verified valid + non-silent, loaded via injectable loader, nearest-root ≤ minor third), audibly distinct on rendered audio (waveform correlation), velocity layers differ, Clav/Digital/Misc honest synthesis.

Focus assigns voice ownership; disabling a layer stops only its voices; disabled layers don't start notes; level scales the layer in the rendered mix; octave ±12 transposes rendered audio; two types sound together; per-layer polyphony/stealing; cleanup to baseline.

KB Touch (Light>Medium>Heavy level), Dyn Comp (narrowed dynamic range, louder soft strokes), Timbre (Soft darker / Bright brighter via >1.5kHz band energy; Dyno 1/2 electric-only), Unison (stereo width + detuned voices), Soft Release (longer tails; disabled for Clav), String Res (sympathetic energy while held), Master Level (scales/mutes final output).
Sustain from UI lifecycle, computer keyboard (spacebar), and MIDI CC64; per-layer SUSTPED gating proven on voice state and rendered tail energy.
Asset failure marks the type failed, Program display reports it, status shows the labeled 'Synthesized fallback' (never 'recorded'), and the type stays playable with audible rendered output.

One render pipeline (shared by browser and tests) produces stereo for both layers; master gain + limiter bound peaks ≤ 1.0 and master zero silences everything; reverb-before-rotary order proven by tail energy; dispose returns to silence.

Per-unit bypass, all-effects bypass, dry/wet, focus (unit edits land on focused chain only), Piano group mode (layers share settings), global mode (Delay/Comp/Reverb apply to all layers), delay feedback filtering inside the loop (dry path untouched, repeats progressively filtered), To Rotary routing, tap tempo.

Every unit and every listed type measurably changes rendered audio and is distinct from the other types in its unit: Mod 1 (6 types), Mod 2 (6), Delay (tempo/feedback), Amp Sim/EQ (Twin/JC/Small distinct, drive, EQ bands, LP24/HP24 opposite spectra), Compressor (dynamic-range reduction, fast recovery), Reverb (Booth→Cathedral decay growth, Spring distinct, bright/dark, fully wet at max), Rotary (slow/fast distinct, drive).
All 11 Phase 1 test files remain present and green (66 inherited assertions), plus the Phase 1 evidence set under evidence/stage1-*.

No hero, no detached rails, no missing keys, width pinned to 94vw with 3.0951 aspect ratio, narrow-viewport media query; pixel evidence in stage2-desktop.png / stage2-narrow.png and stage2-visual-audit.md.
